title: Liquid cooling plate with microchannels
abstract: A cold plate uses parallel microchannels to remove heat from data-center processors.
claims: A cold plate comprising parallel microchannels and a coolant inlet.

title: Coolant flow control for a data center
abstract: Sensors regulate coolant flow according to server workload and temperature.
claims: A controller configured to vary coolant flow using workload and temperature.

title: Rack manifold leak isolation
abstract: A rack manifold isolates a leaking branch while maintaining cooling flow.
claims: A manifold having independently actuated branch isolation valves.

title: Two-phase cooling distribution unit
abstract: A distribution unit controls pressure in a two-phase server cooling loop.
claims: A cooling distribution unit comprising a condenser and pressure controller.

title: Immersion-cooled accelerator enclosure
abstract: An enclosure directs dielectric coolant across accelerator modules.
claims: An accelerator enclosure defining a dielectric coolant flow path.

title: Heat exchanger for liquid-cooled server rooms
abstract: A corrosion-resistant heat exchanger transfers heat from a server liquid loop.
claims: A heat exchanger with corrosion-resistant plates coupled to a server cooling loop.

title: Dielectric coolant monitoring
abstract: Optical and conductivity sensors detect degradation of dielectric coolant.
claims: A monitoring system comprising optical and conductivity sensors in dielectric coolant.
